title: Ender Staff
description: this mod adds an all new enderstaff which can allow you to teleport and also summon dragon breathe
body:
# Ender Staff

**Ender Staff** adds a powerful animated staff to Minecraft that lets players throw ender pearls without carrying them.

The staff uses a custom 3D model, texture, and animation. Its orb remains static while displayed in the inventory but animates while the staff is held in first person or third person.

## Features

* Custom animated 3D Ender Staff model
* Throws an ender pearl when right-clicked
* Does not consume ender pearls from the player’s inventory
* 10-second cooldown after every use
* Cooldown is displayed as the staff’s **Charge**
* Charge restores by 1 point every second
* The staff can only be used when fully charged
* Creates a damaging dragon-breath cloud at the player’s original position after teleporting
* Includes a dedicated **Ender Staff** creative inventory tab
* Static 3D inventory and creative-tab model
* Animated model while held
* Craftable in survival mode

## Crafting Recipe

```text
EFE
GRG
 G 
```

* `E` — Ender Pearl
* `F` — Dragon’s Breath
* `R` — Dragon Head
* `G` — Stick

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.21.1
* NeoForge
* Java 21
* No additional mod dependencies

## Version

**1.0.0**

The Ender Staff is designed for players who want a reusable teleportation item with a visual cooldown and a dangerous dragon-breath effect left behind after escaping.
